verses.text: A psalm of the sons of Korah. A song. The LORD built his city on the holy mountains.
The LORD loves the gates of Zion more than all the other places where the people of Jacob live.
City of God, wonderful things are said about you. Selah.
God says, "I will list Rahab and Babylon among those who know me. Philistia, Tyre, and Ethiopia too. People will say, 'This one was born in Zion.'"
It will be said about Zion, "This one and that one were born there." The Most High himself will make it strong.
When the LORD writes down the names of the nations, he will note, "This one was born there." Selah.
Those who sing and those who dance will say, "All my springs of joy are in you."
